Title: Karan's Day

Cast

1. Karan - 34 years, prince, son
Look: golden crown, red royal robe
2. Anita - 64 years, queen, mother
Look: small crown, pink lehenga

Places

1. The royal court - tall pillars, a golden throne

Scene 1: The royal court - Day

[Karan stands in the court. Anita stands near him.]

Karan: "Today feels like a good day."

[Karan sits down on the throne.]

Karan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Karan unrolls the royal scroll and reads it aloud.]

Anita: "Let's see."

[Karan drinks the poisoned wine and dies.]

Anita: "Rest in peace."
